access_note: Main Nesstar data and documentation are public. One administrative receipt PDF is restricted.
description: CIRAD collaborators surveyed 1,429 Kanak household groups about agriculture, breeding, fishing and hunting activities in New Caledonia during 2010. The sample covers three provinces and ten subterritorial units. The named CIRAD Dataverse page opened publicly; its API lists the Nesstar data file, questionnaire and guidance as public and one administrative receipt as restricted. The current provider page states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and shows no fee. A food-system agent-based modeller could use the survey as a dated baseline for household agricultural and food-provision activities, while keeping the model use an inference, not a claim made by the repository. The 2010 responses cannot describe present livelihoods or infrastructure capacity. Household survey responses also need careful sampling and variable interpretation before simulation. No data file was downloaded. This resource is related to other food-supply datasets in the review but differs from field experiments because it measures human activity. A prior digital-sector screen rejected it for lacking digital terms, which does not address this narrower food-system use.
